sheds.name: 8x12 Economy Shed

sheds.name: 10x12 Utility Shed
sheds.description: A versatile utility shed perfect for storing lawn equipment, tools, and outdoor gear. Durable LP Smart siding stands up to Florida weather. Sales tax included in monthly price.

sheds.name: 10x16 Lofted Barn
sheds.description: Maximize your storage with a spacious loft. The barn-style roof creates overhead storage space for items you don't need daily access to. Sales tax included in monthly price.

sheds.name: 12x16 Side Lofted Barn
sheds.description: Our side lofted barn offers a taller side wall for easy access with a generous loft for extra storage. A customer favorite for workshops. Sales tax included in monthly price.

sheds.name: 12x20 Garage Shed
sheds.description: A full-size garage shed with roll-up door for vehicle or equipment storage. Perfect for ATVs, golf carts, riding mowers, and workshop space. Sales tax included in monthly price.

sheds.name: 12x24 Cabin Shed
sheds.description: Our largest rent-to-own option. The cabin style features a front porch, perfect as a she-shed, man cave, home office, or guest house. Sales tax included in monthly price.
